title: NBA Youngboy & Tekashi 6ix9ine Collaboration Is On The Way, Says Wack 100
htmlContent:
Last week, NBA Young Boy joined Clubhouse and spoke with DJ Akademiks on numerous topics such as possibly signing a record deal and not listening to artists such as Yungeen Ace, 21 Savage, Polo G, and Lil Baby.

During the conversation, Youngboy shared that he would do a single with 6ix9ine because the beef that other artists have with him has nothing to do with him.

“I’ll do a song with 6ix9ine before I do a song with half of these pussy ass n***as, ya hear me?” he said to which Akademiks replied, “The industry gon’ kill you for that.”

“I ain’t got sh*t — I ain’t got nothin’ against him. That sh*t ain’t gon nun to do with me. I wasn’t in his situation. Half of these p***y ass n***as that be talkin’ don’t know what they’d do if they were in his situation. What the f**k that got to do with me or anybody else?”

Speaking of 6ix9ine, Wack 100 was in the Aayan Fix My Life room on the Clubhouse app and confirmed that the single is on the way.

"It's already done," said Wack 100. 6ix9ine's European tour is done; his radio promo is already worked out. Yo, this is me. Business is business."

According to Wack 100, they are just waiting for things to clear before the release of their collaboration. Things have come full circle since NBA Youngboy turned down 6ix9ine after he $1 million.
